# VIKRAM

> Evidence-first Indian equity research and market-intelligence platform.

## Primary
- Website: https://adityavarma1213-star.github.io/Vikram/
- Research: https://adityavarma1213-star.github.io/Vikram/research.html
- Opportunity Radar: https://adityavarma1213-star.github.io/Vikram/#opportunityRadar
- Accumulation Scanner: https://adityavarma1213-star.github.io/Vikram/#scannerSurface

## Principles
VIKRAM emphasizes verified data, provenance, historical validation, explicit data limitations, explainable analysis, and no fabricated market values.

## Important
VIKRAM is a research tool and does not provide investment advice.
